title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2611.29238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. translated_title: GameAnything：从任意灵感创造可玩的游戏世界
translated_abstract: AI驱动的游戏开发具有将多样化的人类灵感转化为互动体验的潜力。然而，现有系统和基准主要聚焦于明确的开发规范，对适配多模态参考素材以及评估实际游戏体验的支持有限。我们提出了GameAnything，一个开源的智能体平台，能够通过迭代开发将多模态灵感转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展。GameAnything将代码生成智能体与独立的试玩评审智能体、持久化的开发状态以及可复用的经验记忆相结合，以支持持续的迭代改进。我们进一步提出了GameAnything-Bench基准，涵盖多样化的参考模态、游戏创作目标和游戏环境，并通过探索性试玩测试来同时评估功能正确性与游戏体验质量。对九种代码生成智能体配置的评估显示……
tldr: 该论文提出了开源智能体平台GameAnything及其配套基准GameAnything-Bench，可将多模态灵感素材通过迭代开发转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展，并同时评估功能正确性与实际游戏体验质量。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that iteratively transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games, together with GameAnything-Bench to evaluate both functional correctness and gameplay quality.
